description: Add a sketch holding one closed rectangle, ready to extrude. Corners are opposite, in inches.

corner1.description: First corner. As [x, y] inches or "x,y".

corner2.description: Opposite corner. As [x, y] inches or "x,y".

elem.description: Element id (tab) — the <elem> segment of the document URL.

name.description: Feature name shown in the tree (default "Sketch").

plane.description: Default plane to sketch on (default Front).

plane_feature.description: Sketch on a face created by this feature id instead of a default plane.

validate.description: Re-read the feature list afterwards and fail if the feature regenerated with an error (default true).

ws.description: Workspace id — the <ws> segment of the document URL.

name: onshape_sketch_rectangle
title: Sketch a rectangle
